notes: Godot 4.7 procedural naval warfare game (US/Soviet campaigns, frigate to battleship). Ships, textures, ocean, sky, terrain, sound, music and the campaign map are generated in code; the repository ships no binary art or audio packs. Coastline data in src/data/geo/ is derived from Natural Earth (public domain). icon.svg is an original ship-and-compass mark (md5 781f06fe35d779b20aa466083c9d0f9f), not the Godot default. No Git LFS, no addons, no editor .tmp, no bundled fonts.
